tasks.literary-genres: Topic: Literary genres in rotation. Cover the features of a novel or novelette, play, and poetry; theme, character, speaker, and viewpoint; and comparing literary texts across genres. Ask learners to identify a genre, describe a character, recognise a theme, match a speaker or viewpoint, notice figurative language, or answer a short contextual question from a poem or scene.
tasks.creative-transactional-writing: Topic: Creative and transactional writing. Cover poems, dialogues, play scripts, messages, and the full writing process from planning to drafting, revising, redrafting, and editing. Ask about audience and purpose, text-type conventions, formal or informal register, planning notes, speaker turns in dialogue, script features, and paragraph coherence.
tasks.language-extension: Topic: Language extension. Cover vocabulary building through synonyms, antonyms, and idioms, plus tense control, punctuation, spelling, and editing your own writing. Ask language-in-context items about word meaning, accurate word choice, tense consistency, sentence editing, punctuation marks, and checking spelling or grammar in short sentences.
